text:
The mood conveyed in the text is one of communal resilience and serene harmony with nature. The imagery of seagulls, weathered nets, and the "briny kiss" of the ocean mist creates an atmosphere that is both rustic and deeply connected to the rhythms of the sea. This atmosphere contributes to the narrative by establishing a strong sense of place and character, highlighting the villagers' shared destiny and their enduring strength in the face of their environment.

The country known for the Eiffel Tower is France.
